svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 760 260' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' font-family='Inter, sans-serif' font-size='12'>

  <!-- Step 1: Raw Text -->
  <rect x='10' y='60' width='100' height='60' rx='8' fill='#f1f5f9' stroke='#94a3b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <text x='60' y='84' text-anchor='middle' fill='#475569' font-weight='700' font-size='11'>Raw Text</text>
  <text x='60' y='100' text-anchor='middle' fill='#64748b' font-size='10'>"The quick</text>
  <text x='60' y='113' text-anchor='middle' fill='#64748b' font-size='10'>brown fox..."</text>

  <!-- Arrow -->
  <line x1='110' y1='90' x2='128' y2='90' stroke='#94a3b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='128,86 138,90 128,94' fill='#94a3b8'/>

  <!-- Step 2: Tokenize -->
  <rect x='140' y='55' width='100' height='70' rx='8' fill='#ede9fe' stroke='#a78bfa' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='140' y='55' width='100' height='22' rx='8' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <rect x='140' y='69' width='100' height='8' fill='#a78bfa'/>
  <text x='190' y='69' text-anchor='middle' fill='white' font-weight='700' font-size='11'>Tokenize</text>
  <text x='190' y='90' text-anchor='middle' fill='#4c1d95' font-size='10'>["The", "quick",</text>
  <text x='190' y='104' text-anchor='middle' fill='#4c1d95' font-size='10'>"brown", "fox"]</text>
  <text x='190' y='118' text-anchor='middle' fill='#7c3aed' font-size='9'>split into words</text>

  <!-- Arrow -->
  <line x1='240' y1='90' x2='258' y2='90' stroke='#94a3b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='258,86 268,90 258,94' fill='#94a3b8'/>

  <!-- Step 3: Stop words -->
  <rect x='270' y='55' width='100' height='70' rx='8' fill='#fce7f3' stroke='#f472b6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='270' y='55' width='100' height='22' rx='8' fill='#f472b6'/>
  <rect x='270' y='69' width='100' height='8' fill='#f472b6'/>
  <text x='320' y='69' text-anchor='middle' fill='white' font-weight='700' font-size='11'>Stop Words</text>
  <text x='320' y='90' text-anchor='middle' fill='#831843' font-size='10' text-decoration='line-through'>~~"The"~~</text>
  <text x='320' y='104' text-anchor='middle' fill='#831843' font-size='10'>["quick", "brown",</text>
  <text x='320' y='118' text-anchor='middle' fill='#831843' font-size='9'>"fox"] removed</text>

  <!-- Arrow -->
  <line x1='370' y1='90' x2='388' y2='90' stroke='#94a3b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='388,86 398,90 388,94' fill='#94a3b8'/>

  <!-- Step 4: Stemming -->
  <rect x='400' y='55' width='100' height='70' rx='8' fill='#fff7ed' stroke='#F5A673' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <rect x='400' y='55' width='100' height='22' rx='8' fill='#F5A673'/>
  <rect x='400' y='69' width='100' height='8' fill='#F5A673'/>
  <text x='450' y='69' text-anchor='middle' fill='white' font-weight='700' font-size='11'>Stemming</text>
  <text x='450' y='90' text-anchor='middle' fill='#9a3412' font-size='10'>running → run</text>
  <text x='450' y='104' text-anchor='middle' fill='#9a3412' font-size='10'>foxes → fox</text>
  <text x='450' y='118' text-anchor='middle' fill='#b45309' font-size='9'>root forms only</text>

  <!-- Arrow -->
  <line x1='500' y1='90' x2='518' y2='90' stroke='#94a3b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='518,86 528,90 518,94' fill='#94a3b8'/>

  <!-- Step 5: TF-IDF -->
  <rect x='530' y='50' width='110' height='80' rx='8' fill='#fefce8' stroke='#E8B84B' stroke-width='2'/>
  <rect x='530' y='50' width='110' height='24' rx='8' fill='#E8B84B'/>
  <rect x='530' y='66' width='110' height='8' fill='#E8B84B'/>
  <text x='585' y='67' text-anchor='middle' fill='white' font-weight='700' font-size='11'>TF-IDF Vector</text>
  <text x='585' y='88' text-anchor='middle' fill='#713f12' font-size='10'>quick: 0.42</text>
  <text x='585' y='102' text-anchor='middle' fill='#713f12' font-size='10'>brown: 0.31</text>
  <text x='585' y='116' text-anchor='middle' fill='#713f12' font-size='10'>fox: 0.58</text>
  <text x='585' y='124' text-anchor='middle' fill='#92400e' font-size='9'>numerical matrix</text>

  <!-- Arrow -->
  <line x1='640' y1='90' x2='658' y2='90' stroke='#94a3b8' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <polygon points='658,86 668,90 658,94' fill='#94a3b8'/>

  <!-- Step 6: Downstream -->
  <rect x='670' y='45' width='80' height='30' rx='6' fill='#f0fdf4' stroke='#4ade80' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <text x='710' y='64' text-anchor='middle' fill='#14532d' font-size='10' font-weight='600'>Classify</text>
  <rect x='670' y='82' width='80' height='30' rx='6' fill='#dbeafe' stroke='#60a5fa' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <text x='710' y='101' text-anchor='middle' fill='#1e40af' font-size='10' font-weight='600'>Cluster</text>
  <rect x='670' y='119' width='80' height='30' rx='6' fill='#fce7f3' stroke='#f472b6' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <text x='710' y='138' text-anchor='middle' fill='#831843' font-size='10' font-weight='600'>Topic Model</text>

  <!-- Step labels below -->
  <text x='60' y='148' text-anchor='middle' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='10'>1. Input</text>
  <text x='190' y='148' text-anchor='middle' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='10'>2. Tokenize</text>
  <text x='320' y='148' text-anchor='middle' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='10'>3. Clean</text>
  <text x='450' y='148' text-anchor='middle' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='10'>4. Normalize</text>
  <text x='585' y='148' text-anchor='middle' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='10'>5. Vectorize</text>
  <text x='710' y='168' text-anchor='middle' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='10'>6. Model</text>

  <!-- Example document bar -->
  <rect x='10' y='185' width='740' height='55' rx='8' fill='#f8fafc' stroke='#e2e8f0' stroke-width='1'/>
  <text x='30' y='205' fill='#64748b' font-size='11' font-weight='600'>Example:</text>
  <text x='30' y='222' fill='#374151' font-size='11'>"Refund not processed after 14 days"  →  [refund: 0.71, process: 0.54, day: 0.38]  →  routed to: Billing team</text>
  <text x='30' y='235' fill='#94a3b8' font-size='10'>"the", "not", "after" dropped as stop words. "processed" → "process", "days" → "day" via stemming.</text>
</svg>
